title: Decapod environment refresh and governed publication
purpose: Record the falsifiable claim and evidence that the refreshed Decapod environment can validate and publish this profile repository.

authority.change_policy: Update through a reviewed pull request with refreshed validation and evidence artifacts.

in_scope: Managed project specs and governance artifacts
out_of_scope: GitHub merge approval or deployment success
Claims about Decapod releases other than the measured 0.82.1 run

methodology.falsifiability_standard: A claim is supported only when the named repository artifacts and bounded command produce the stated result.

measurement_rules.name: Validation failure count
measurement_rules.requirement: The governed validation command exits successfully with zero failed gates.

claims.title: Refreshed environment passes governed validation
claims.statement: After the Decapod 0.82.1 environment was refreshed and its governed artifacts were included, the repository passed containerized decapod validation with zero failed gates.
claims.why_it_matters: Agents need a reproducible environment repair path that makes governance validation actionable across Decapod release changes.

baseline.description: The pre-refresh worktree lacked current entrypoint fingerprints, managed-spec allowlist rules, and the governed plan artifact.
baseline.population: The alexhraber repository checkout before the Decapod refresh.
protocol: Run decapod validate before refreshing the environment.
Record each failed governance gate and missing artifact.
controls: Use the protected repository state as the comparison checkout.
Do not change application source files during the environment comparison.
confounders: Pre-existing stale local TODO proof state.
Warnings for unrelated stale workspace and watcher records.

decapod_condition.description: The worktree after Decapod 0.82.1 re-init, managed artifact inclusion, and proof-state refresh.
decapod_condition.population: The isolated PR worktree for alexhraber/alexhraber#5.
protocol: Run decapod validate in the prepared container workspace.
Record the pass and failure counts in validation.json.
Compare the result with the acceptance criteria.
controls: Use the same repository and Decapod release for the measured run.
Keep workspaces and local data outside the committed governance artifact set.
confounders: GitHub Actions may use a different runner image.
The PR remains subject to remote CI and human review.

failure_modes.description: A governance gate fails after the refresh.
failure_modes.observable_signal: validation.json reports one or more failed gates or a non-zero command result.
failure_modes.falsifier: A fresh containerized decapod validate run exits non-zero or reports a failed gate.

measurements.name: Failed validation gates
measurements.definition: The number of failed gates reported by the final Decapod validation run.
measurements.collection_method: Read the summary from the containerized decapod validate run.

required_artifacts.relationship: Records the governed run that produced the proof.

acceptance_criteria: The validation summary reports zero failed gates.
The required governance artifacts are present in the PR diff.
proof_gate.failure_behavior: Do not claim the environment refresh is validated; report the failed gate and preserve the evidence for repair.

open_questions.question: Does the GitHub Actions runner reproduce the local containerized validation result?
open_questions.decision_impact: A mismatch would require CI image or bootstrap changes in the upstream Decapod issue.

evidence.summary: The final containerized validation run reported 188 passed gates and zero failed gates.

sources.description: Tracked Decapod validation receipt for the refreshed worktree.
Upstream issue documenting the old-to-new environment migration failure mode.
Repository contract requiring Decapod validation and governed workspace isolation.

observations.result: Containerized decapod validate completed with 188 passed gates and 0 failed gates.

non_guarantees: This ledger does not prove that GitHub Actions has completed successfully.
This ledger does not prove that all future Decapod releases will migrate without changes.

governance.review_policy: Review changes to claims, evidence status, or proof gates in a pull request.
governance.new_capability_rule: A new capability claim requires a named artifact, bounded command, and falsifier before promotion.
